description: Recorded gameplay demo through the published sp_a1_intro4_relit map, recorded by the user on ./play_p2_fsr (2026-10-05) as the fixture for in-game performance and stutter work. Played back in real time (playdemo) by tools/quality/demo_frames.py; every presented frame of the playback window is reported. Diagnostic workload: no budget row, no acceptance claim.

playback_window.description: The demo carries no frame marks. The window starts at the first frame of the first run of settle_frames consecutive frames that each draw the world (records above min_records) and present within settle_interval_ms; level-load frames come before it. The final frame (the quit) is excluded.
